description: This Dart source file implements a Flutter application that displays a QR code linking to a visitor form. It loads configuration from environment variables or build-time flags, and presents a user interface with instructions and the generated QR code.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter application, setting up theme and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: Main page displaying QR code linked to visitor form URL.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: Stateful widget class managing the visitor form URL display and QR code generation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that initializes Flutter bindings and loads environment variables before running the app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for MyApp and MyHomePage, constructing the UI.

methods.name: targetUrl
methods.description: Getter that determines the URL to encode in the QR code by checking environment variables and build-time flags, with a fallback.
